subject: Dashboard backend selector + per-provider install/auth status + local-CLI AV-awareness message
description:
Add a backend selector to the orchestrator dashboard (the /graph dashboard UI + any served assets). Builds on /16's GET/POST /config/backend (merged into orch/feature/pluggable-backend). Branch off the feature.
1. Selector UI: fetch GET /config/backend, render the provider list each with its detected isAvailable/isAuthed badge (installed? authed?), highlight the active one; selecting + saving issues POST /config/backend {provider, model?}.
2. **Local-CLI AV-awareness message (USER REQUIREMENT):** when the user selects/has-selected a local-CLI (agentic-cli kind: Claude/Codex/Cursor) backend, show a clear, persistent notice: this backend spawns local CLI processes (claude -p / codex / cursor) in the background, which some antivirus (e.g. Kaspersky) flags or intercepts as suspicious hidden-process behavior; recommend either adding an AV exclusion for the CLI/node, or switching to the API backend (which runs in-process with no child process and is not subject to this). This is the explicit user ask: "make user aware when they set CLI backend to be their local claude code."
3. Keep it consistent with the existing dashboard's styling/serving (find how the current dashboard HTML/JS is served — likely a public/ asset or an inline route — and extend that).
Tests/verification appropriate to the dashboard layer (endpoint round-trip; the AV notice renders for agentic-cli selection, not for api). SCOPE: dashboard UI + the AV message only — NOT new backend providers, NOT the api impl. Blocked by /16.

summary: Dashboard backend selector + per-provider readiness + local-CLI AV notice. Dashboard is public/graph.html (served by routes/ui.js at GET /graph; fully inline JS, no bundler). Added an 'LLM backend' section to the settings popup (⚙): on open it calls GET /config/backend (via dfetch, workspace-scoped) and renders each provider with displayName, kind, and a readiness badge from isAvailable/isAuthed (api's null isAvailable → 'hosted, no install'); the active provider gets an 'active' tag. Selecting a provider + optional model and 'Save backend' POSTs /config/backend, surfaces a 400 for unknown ids, and re-fetches to refresh readiness. The EXPLICIT requirement — a persistent antivirus-awareness notice — is gated on the SELECTED provider's kind: shown for agentic-cli (spawns hidden 'claude -p' child), hidden for api (in-process). Pure logic extracted to lib/backend-ui.js (shouldShowAvNotice/avNoticeText/providerReadiness) as the tested source of truth; graph.html keeps a byte-identical inline copy. Verified: node test/backend-ui.test.js 18/18; node --check on lib/backend-ui.js, routes/config.js, and both extracted graph.html script blocks; live GET→POST→GET→400→clear round-trip against a private-port feature daemon 10/10. Scope-fenced: no server changes (/16), no new providers, no real API backend. Committed 99b7faf on orch/attempt/...-20.
